title.purpose: Product lockup in the sticky header.

body.purpose: Default interface copy, buttons, field values, timeline step names.

label.purpose: Metric captions, field dts, helper text. Sentence case.

motion.name: ease-standard

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Committed next action on the bench (Process).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><polygon points="6 3 20 12 6 21 6 3"/></svg>Process</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.8rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-icon { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; flex: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.8rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Station on the bench: header, body, optional muted footer.
components.html:
Upload image

PNG, JPEG, WEBP • Max 10MB

Drop a scan to begin.
Ready to process.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) * 1.4); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-header { padding: 1rem 1rem 0; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-card-body { padding: 0 1rem; } .ds-card-footer { margin-top: auto; padding: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Secondary Badge
components.description: Quiet meta chip (F0 Demo, completed status).
components.css: .ds-badge-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) * 2.6); background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Default Badge
components.css: .ds-badge-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) * 2.6); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-default:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Alert
components.description: Inline upload or pipeline error. Audit Red is the only chroma.
components.html:
Upload error

Invalid file type. Use PNG, JPEG, or WEBP.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 0.125rem 0.5rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--card); color: var(--destructive); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-alert-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; margin-top: 0.125rem; } .ds-alert-title { font-weight: 500; } .ds-alert-desc { margin: 0; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 90%, transparent); }

components.name: Dropzone
components.description: Signature file well. Dashed hairline; ink dash while dragging.
components.html: Drag and drop an image here, or click to browse.
components.css: .ds-dropzone { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; border: 2px dashed var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) * 1.4); background: var(--background); color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-dropzone:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 40%, transparent); } .ds-dropzone:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent); } .ds-dropzone-icon { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; } .ds-dropzone p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: Telemetry cell: mute label over tabular value.
components.css: .ds-metric { padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) * 0.8); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); } .ds-metric-label { font: 400 0.75rem/1.33 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-metric-value { font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: In-card view switch (Fields / Raw JSON). Shadow only on the active thumb.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--muted); } .ds-tab { height: calc(100% - 1px); padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) * 0.8); background: transparent; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 60%, transparent); font: 500 0.875rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Progress
components.description: 4px meter for pipeline step and Ollama memory.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 0.25rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--muted); } .ds-progress-ind { display: block; width: 35%; height: 100%; background: var(--primary); transition: width 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

narrative.overview:
This is an operate surface for reading invoices, not a marketing page. The Proof Room now runs at night: a Cursor/Vercel-grade black console where a scan is checked, fields are confirmed, and missing evidence stays missing. Personality is austere and operational. Brand lives in white ink on void, hairline rings, and a single chromatic exception.

Density is high and even. Geist carries every voice (the same face Vercel ships); Geist Mono appears only when the content is raw. Surfaces recede as graphite panels on true black. The visitor's success is finishing the job: upload, watch the pipeline, read the structured result, trust the telemetry or see that it is unavailable.

The system rejects the SaaS card kit and the cream-paper Proof Room: no grey drop shadows, no decorative gradients, no neon accent, no tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-default black-and-white; chroma reserved for errors
Geist + Geist Mono; compact operate type scale (no display hero)
Flat surfaces at rest; hairline + frost instead of structural shadow
White primary action on black canvas
Unavailable metrics render as “—”, never as invented precision

rules.name: The Rare Ink Rule
rules.body: Audit Red is the only chromatic voice. It appears only for errors, invalid state, and destructive actions. Neutrals do the rest.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Quantities, costs, durations, and token counts use tabular-nums. Missing telemetry is an em dash (“—”), never a fabricated figure.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (active tab, focus). Cards never wear a resting drop shadow.

dos: Do speak through semantic tokens (`primary`, `muted`, `destructive`, `border`) so light and dark stay one system.
Do render missing telemetry as “—” or an explicit unavailable alert (The Tabular Truth Rule).
Do keep cards flat with a 10% ink ring; put frost only on the sticky header.
Do keep type compact: body at 14px, labels at 12px, no display hero on operate surfaces.
Do reserve Audit Red for error, invalid, and destructive — nowhere else (The Rare Ink Rule).
donts: Don't add resting grey drop shadows or decorative gradients under cards (SaaS card kit).
Don't introduce tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows, middle-dot meta strings as ornament, or a second display face.
Don't invent confidence, cost, or memory numbers when the backend did not provide them.
Don't use Geist Mono for chrome or labels; it is for raw dumps only.
Don't promote a page-specific layout (the two-column bench) into a global marketing grid.
